forecast_protocol.question: Does a fixed learned ranking add retrieval value beyond simple rules on later periods?
forecast_protocol.later_origin_status: Not scored by this repair workflow; prior user exposure is unknown. Not a blind-test claim.
forecast_protocol.assumed_gap: Three full date labels t-3,t-2,t-1; all training outcome dates must also be <=t-4.
forecast_protocol.availability_limitation: Retrospective final release; no historical ingestion vintages. Buffer is an assumption, not verified availability.
forecast_protocol.date_convention: Warehouse report_date labels, without timezone conversion; source timezone not independently verified.
forecast_protocol.training: Exactly the last three mature episode origins, pooled page-episodes; no shorter fallback history.
forecast_protocol.primary_population: As-of eligible pages of clients with a labelable row in the rolling training frame.
forecast_protocol.eligibility: 28 explicit available prior daily rows; I>0, C>0, finite positive impression-weighted position. Sparse/missing days are not zero-filled.
forecast_protocol.outcome_observability: 28 explicit available outcome rows with valid counts; otherwise unknown, retained in the as-of queue.
forecast_protocol.label: 9*I_prior<=10*I_outcome<=11*I_prior and 20*C_outcome<=17*C_prior
forecast_protocol.primary_reporting: Rank all eligible pages before outcome filtering. Report observed hits, unknowns, bounds; point precision only for fully observed queues.
forecast_protocol.secondary_reporting: Complete-case metrics, support >=5/20 without refitting, anonymous client contributions.
forecast_protocol.tie_policy: Descending score, stable canonical client/content key order; conditional tie ranges also reported.
forecast_protocol.hash_holdout: sha256(flyrank-fix05-v1|client_id) mod 4 == 0; excluded from all hash-arm training; descriptive.

models.preprocessing: Independent StandardScaler per model, four numeric features only; no tuning or winner selection.

forecast_protocol.rules: Training-only position bands (0,3,10,20,50,infinity); medians or pooled CTR; visibility at training median I. High prior counts/CTR rank first.
forecast_protocol.unseen_band_fallback: Global training median CTR for original rule; global pooled training CTR for pooled rules.
forecast_protocol.final_month: June 2026 is excluded, including the sample table.
forecast_protocol.inference_limits: Repeated pages and clients; no iid page confidence intervals. Few periods/clients may preclude a strong claim.
forecast_protocol.changes_from_stage2: Numeric-only features, lagged schedule, rolling fitting, different client split and as-of queues. Changes cannot be attributed solely to time splitting.

count_reference_protocol.purpose: Describe raw event counts against a simple stationary click-allocation reference.
count_reference_protocol.source: Existing Fix05 page-episode aggregates and unchanged cohorts; no new warehouse query or model fit.
count_reference_protocol.population: Complete-case members of each fixed Fix05 arm, restricted to 1<=prior+future clicks<=200.
count_reference_protocol.cap_reason: Predeclared computational scope for the low-total-count diagnostic; total clicks are conditioned on by the reference.
count_reference_protocol.null: Independent Bernoulli clicks per impression with one common page CTR in the two windows.
count_reference_protocol.conditioning: Both impression totals, the combined click total, and prior clicks>0.
count_reference_protocol.reference: Future clicks X ~ Hypergeometric(M=I0+I1,n=C0+C1,N=I1), truncated to X<=C0+C1-1.
count_reference_protocol.computation: Finite-support hypergeometric weights from log-ratio recurrence; batches of at most 4096 rows.
count_reference_protocol.reporting: Observed signatures beside sum of conditional probabilities on exactly the same modeled subset.
count_reference_protocol.prior_click_bands: Observed counts only. No reference expectation is reported by observed prior-click band.
count_reference_protocol.not_forecast: Reference uses future impressions and clicks. It is outcome analysis, never a predictor or ranking baseline.
limitations: The common-CTR independent-click model may fail under temporal dependence, changing query mix, seasonality or heterogeneous exposure.
Complete-case retention must be ignorable under this conditional reference; outcome-dependent observation can invalidate it.
Other eligibility/arm membership is treated as fixed under the reference.
Total-click restriction uses future counts and does not redefine the main prediction population.
No false-positive fraction, equivalence, calibrated hypothesis test, confidence interval or causal attribution follows.
Arms overlap and monthly pages/clients repeat; do not pool them as independent evidence.

paired_diagnostic_protocol.population: Unchanged Fix05 known-client as-of eligible frames; no total-click cap or future-outcome filtering.
paired_diagnostic_protocol.replay: Four fits of unchanged LR settings recover the original predictions. Require exact prediction hashes for LR, prior CTR and pooled CTR excess.
paired_diagnostic_protocol.models: No new candidate, tuning or Random-Forest fit. All eight original Fix05 results remain retained.
paired_diagnostic_protocol.tie_policy: Stable descending scores in original canonical client/content order.
paired_diagnostic_protocol.pair_bound: Let d be known-positive A-only minus B-only. Bounds on P50(A)-P50(B) are (d-unknown_B_only)/50 and (d+unknown_A_only)/50.
paired_diagnostic_protocol.overlap: Shared pages, including shared unknown outcomes, cancel exactly in a paired difference.
paired_diagnostic_protocol.client_influence: Delete each eligible client once, rerank fixed predictions on remaining pages at the same K. Do not refit after deletion.
limitations: Missing-data bounds apply to these finite queues under the frozen tie policy; they are not confidence intervals.
Client deletion measures evaluation-portfolio sensitivity, not uncertainty of training or unseen-client model performance.
Repeated clients/pages and only two later periods limit generalization. No iid tests or bootstrap confidence intervals.
Diagnostic comparisons are exploratory, not a new blind confirmation or a change of the primary prediction task.
Counterfactual missing labels may have additional unmodeled constraints; reported bounds allow any binary labels for exclusive unknowns.
No warehouse query or June access.

protocol.purpose: Reproduce repaired February-May analyses without continuation-cell dependencies.
protocol.interpretation: No blind-test, causal, equivalence or population-wide ML-failure claim.
